text: EdgeConneX is owned by EQT's infrastructure funds: EQT Infrastructure's acquisition of EdgeConneX closed in November 2020, and after EQT sold a minority stake to Sixth Street-managed funds in September 2024, EQT Infrastructure remained the largest shareholder.
short: EdgeConneX is owned by EQT's infrastructure funds; EQT remains its largest shareholder, Sixth Street holds a minority.

source.name: EdgeConneX press release: EdgeConneX Announces Completion of its Acquisition by EQT Infrastructure
source.quote: announced today that its acquisition by EQT Infrastructure from an investor group led by Providence Equity Partners has closed

additionalSources.name: Sixth Street newsroom: EQT Welcomes Sixth Street as Strategic Investor in EdgeConneX
additionalSources.quote: Having been invested in the company since 2020, EQT Infrastructure will remain the largest shareholder following the closing of the transaction.
